title: 网络安全 · SOC 与检测工程 30 句
description: 覆盖日志接入、检测设计、告警研判、规则调优、自动化、威胁狩猎与 SOC 度量的高级英语表达。

items.zh: 日志源接入前应确认它支持哪个检测用例，而不是仅因为数据可用就全部采集。
items.en: Before a log source is onboarded, the team should identify which detection use case it supports rather than collect it merely because it is available.
answers: Before a log source is onboarded, the team should identify which detection use case it supports rather than collect it merely because it is available.
items.notes: which 引导识别内容；rather than doing 对比价值驱动与盲目采集。

items.zh: 身份日志缺少结果字段时，分析师无法区分成功登录与失败尝试。
items.en: When identity logs lack an outcome field, analysts cannot distinguish successful authentication from a failed attempt.
answers: When identity logs lack an outcome field, analysts cannot distinguish successful authentication from a failed attempt.
items.notes: distinguish A from B；when 引出日志质量问题。

items.zh: 采集健康状态必须独立监控，否则日志中断可能被误认为环境中没有活动。
items.en: Collection health must be monitored independently; otherwise, a logging failure may be mistaken for an absence of activity.
answers: Collection health must be monitored independently; otherwise, a logging failure may be mistaken for an absence of activity.
items.notes: otherwise 引出误判后果；mistake A for B 表示把 A 误当 B。

items.zh: 时间戳统一为标准时区后，来自不同系统的事件才能可靠排序。
items.en: Events from different systems can be sequenced reliably only after their timestamps have been normalised to a common time zone.
answers: Events from different systems can be sequenced reliably only after their timestamps have been normalised to a common time zone.
items.notes: only after 强调前提；normalise to 表示统一为某标准。

items.zh: 字段解析错误没有减少原始日志数量，却会使依赖该字段的检测静默失效。
items.en: A field-parsing error does not reduce raw event volume, but it can silently disable detections that depend on that field.
answers: A field-parsing error does not reduce raw event volume, but it can silently disable detections that depend on that field.
items.notes: but 揭示隐蔽后果；that 引导定语从句。

items.zh: 一条有效检测应说明要发现的攻击行为、所需数据以及可能的规避方式。
items.en: An effective detection should specify the adversary behaviour, the data required, and the ways in which the logic might be evaded.
answers: An effective detection should specify the adversary behaviour, the data required, and the ways in which the logic might be evaded.
items.notes: 三个并列宾语覆盖目标、依赖和限制；in which 引导定语从句。

items.zh: 规则以行为序列为基础，因此比单个文件哈希更能适应工具变化。
items.en: The rule is based on a sequence of behaviours and is therefore more resilient to changes in tooling than a single file hash.
answers: The rule is based on a sequence of behaviours and is therefore more resilient to changes in tooling than a single file hash.
items.notes: more ... than 构成比较；resilient to 是固定搭配。

items.zh: 阈值应反映环境的正常基线，而不能直接复制另一家组织的数值。
items.en: A threshold should reflect the environment's normal baseline rather than a value copied directly from another organisation.
answers: A threshold should reflect the environment's normal baseline rather than a value copied directly from another organisation.
items.notes: rather than 对比环境化阈值与照搬数值；copied 作后置定语。

items.zh: 检测逻辑记录了已知盲区，使分析师知道哪些相关活动不会生成告警。
items.en: The detection logic documents known blind spots so that analysts understand which related activities will not generate an alert.
answers: The detection logic documents known blind spots so that analysts understand which related activities will not generate an alert.
items.notes: so that 表示文档目的；which 引导盲区内容。

items.zh: 在启用阻断之前，团队先以只告警模式评估该规则对正常业务的影响。
items.en: Before enabling prevention, the team evaluates the rule in alert-only mode to assess its effect on legitimate activity.
answers: Before enabling prevention, the team evaluates the rule in alert-only mode to assess its effect on legitimate activity.
items.notes: before doing 表示分阶段实施；to assess 说明试运行目的。

items.zh: 分析师把告警与资产关键性结合起来，避免用同一优先级处理所有匹配项。
items.en: The analyst combines the alert with asset criticality to avoid treating every match with the same priority.
answers: The analyst combines the alert with asset criticality to avoid treating every match with the same priority.
items.notes: combine A with B；avoid doing 表示避免一刀切。

items.zh: 看似异常的管理员登录得到维护窗口支持，因此被记录为良性真阳性。
items.en: The apparently unusual administrator login was supported by the maintenance window and was therefore recorded as a benign true positive.
answers: The apparently unusual administrator login was supported by the maintenance window and was therefore recorded as a benign true positive.
items.notes: be supported by context 表示有背景证据；therefore 给出研判结果。

items.zh: 一次告警可能包含多个实体，调查不能在第一个账户得到解释后就停止。
items.en: A single alert may contain several entities, so the investigation should not stop when the first account has been explained.
answers: A single alert may contain several entities, so the investigation should not stop when the first account has been explained.
items.notes: may 表示可能；should not stop when 防止过早结束调查。

items.zh: 如果端点已经离线，分析师应寻找身份和网络证据，而不是等待单一数据源恢复。
items.en: If the endpoint is offline, the analyst should seek identity and network evidence rather than wait for one data source to return.
answers: If the endpoint is offline, the analyst should seek identity and network evidence rather than wait for one data source to return.
items.notes: if 引出数据缺失情境；rather than 对比调查策略。

items.zh: 关闭告警时应记录判断依据，使后续人员能够复核相同证据。
items.en: The rationale for closing an alert should be recorded so that another analyst can review the same evidence later.
answers: The rationale for closing an alert should be recorded so that another analyst can review the same evidence later.
items.notes: rationale for doing 表示判断依据；so that 说明可复核目的。

items.zh: 调优应移除没有风险意义的噪声，同时保留同类恶意行为可能呈现的信号。
items.en: Tuning should remove noise with no risk significance while preserving signals that malicious activity of the same type might produce.
answers: Tuning should remove noise with no risk significance while preserving signals that malicious activity of the same type might produce.
items.notes: while doing 表示两项目标平衡；that 引导定语从句。

items.zh: 按用户姓名排除告警很脆弱，因为账户用途或所有者可能在规则更新前改变。
items.en: Suppressing an alert by username is fragile because the account's purpose or owner may change before the rule is reviewed.
answers: Suppressing an alert by username is fragile because the account's purpose or owner may change before the rule is reviewed.
items.notes: 动名词作主语；because 解释脆弱性。

items.zh: 规则修改后要用真实历史事件回测，以确认检测能力没有意外下降。
items.en: After a rule is modified, it should be tested against genuine historical events to confirm that detection capability has not regressed.
answers: After a rule is modified, it should be tested against genuine historical events to confirm that detection capability has not regressed.
items.notes: test against 表示用样本测试；has not regressed 表示能力未退化。

items.zh: 误报率下降可能源于更好调优，也可能源于日志停止采集，因此需要结合健康指标判断。
items.en: A lower false-positive rate may reflect better tuning or failed log collection, so it must be interpreted alongside health metrics.
answers: A lower false-positive rate may reflect better tuning or failed log collection, so it must be interpreted alongside health metrics.
items.notes: may reflect A or B 提出竞争解释；alongside 表示结合。

items.zh: 规则版本记录把每次修改与测试证据关联起来，以便出现漏报时追溯。
items.en: Rule versioning links each change to its test evidence so that a missed detection can be traced later.
answers: Rule versioning links each change to its test evidence so that a missed detection can be traced later.
items.notes: link A to B；so that 说明可追溯目的。

items.zh: 自动化剧本先收集低风险上下文，只有达到明确置信度才执行遏制。
items.en: The automation playbook gathers low-risk context first and performs containment only when a defined confidence threshold is met.
answers: The automation playbook gathers low-risk context first and performs containment only when a defined confidence threshold is met.
items.notes: only when 限定自动处置条件；被动结构强调阈值达成。

items.zh: 如果外部服务超时，剧本应保留案件并转给人员，而不是把调查标记为完成。
items.en: If an external service times out, the playbook should preserve the case for human review rather than mark the investigation as complete.
answers: If an external service times out, the playbook should preserve the case for human review rather than mark the investigation as complete.
items.notes: if 引出异常分支；mark A as B 是固定结构。

items.zh: 自动封禁必须有明确回退路径，因为错误处置可能扩大业务影响。
items.en: Automated blocking requires a clear reversal path because an incorrect response could amplify the business impact.
answers: Automated blocking requires a clear reversal path because an incorrect response could amplify the business impact.
items.notes: require 表示必要条件；could amplify 表示可能扩大影响。

items.zh: 编排平台保存执行输入和结果，让团队可以审计机器为何采取该行动。
items.en: The orchestration platform retains execution inputs and outcomes, allowing the team to audit why an automated action was taken.
answers: The orchestration platform retains execution inputs and outcomes, allowing the team to audit why an automated action was taken.
items.notes: allowing 作结果补充；why 引导审计内容。

items.zh: 适合自动化的是稳定且重复的决策，而不是仍需大量上下文判断的事件。
items.en: Stable, repeatable decisions are better candidates for automation than incidents that still require substantial contextual judgement.
answers: Stable, repeatable decisions are better candidates for automation than incidents that still require substantial contextual judgement.
items.notes: better ... than 构成适用性比较；that 引导定语从句。

items.zh: 威胁狩猎提出可证伪的假设，因此没有结果时也能形成有边界的结论。
items.en: Threat hunting uses a falsifiable hypothesis so that even a negative result can produce a bounded conclusion.
answers: Threat hunting uses a falsifiable hypothesis so that even a negative result can produce a bounded conclusion.
items.notes: so that 表示方法带来的结果；falsifiable hypothesis 是专业术语。

items.zh: 狩猎发现的新模式会先转化为实验性检测，再经过一段时间调优。
items.en: A new pattern found during hunting is converted into an experimental detection before being tuned over time.
answers: A new pattern found during hunting is converted into an experimental detection before being tuned over time.
items.notes: found 作后置定语；before being tuned 是被动非谓语结构。

items.zh: 平均关闭时间不能单独衡量 SOC 表现，因为快速关闭误报并不等于快速控制攻击。
items.en: Mean time to closure cannot measure SOC performance alone, because closing false positives quickly is not the same as containing attacks quickly.
answers: Mean time to closure cannot measure SOC performance alone, because closing false positives quickly is not the same as containing attacks quickly.
items.notes: is not the same as 区分速度指标含义；动名词短语作主语。

items.zh: 积压趋势应按严重性和年龄拆分，否则少量长期高风险案件会被总数掩盖。
items.en: Backlog trends should be broken down by severity and age; otherwise, a few long-running high-risk cases may be hidden by the total.
answers: Backlog trends should be broken down by severity and age; otherwise, a few long-running high-risk cases may be hidden by the total.
items.notes: break down by 表示按维度拆分；otherwise 说明汇总风险。

items.zh: 检测覆盖率只有映射到相关威胁并经过测试，才比规则数量更有意义。
items.en: Detection coverage is more meaningful than a rule count only when it is mapped to relevant threats and validated through testing.
answers: Detection coverage is more meaningful than a rule count only when it is mapped to relevant threats and validated through testing.
items.notes: more meaningful than 构成指标比较；only when 给出可信条件。
